title: Morning sync — whiteboard capture & loose decisions (2026-04-21)
content:
FRAGMENTED NOTES / capture from 2026-04-21 morning sync (whiteboard scribbles)

Attendees: Lena, TJ, Priya, Ethan, Samira (+ quick ping from Omar)

Goal: quick alignment on canary instrumentation, rollout visibility, and small UI pain points before the sprint review. This doc = raw capture; convert to actionable tickets after lunch.

1) Observability sketch (whiteboard)
- draw: timeline -> request enters routing -> model variant selection -> canary branch (10%) -> fallback path -> metrics emitted at three points: inbound-latency, model-latency, fallback-rate.
- Decision: emit a 1s/5s bucketed latency histogram at the ingress and post-model stages. Keep tag keys: route, model_variant, customer_tier.
- Open Q: do we use existing metrics lib or attach a lightweight lambda to emit enriched tags? TJ prefers reuse of infra lib; Priya wants tags in front-end layer for per-route breakdown. Action: TJ to prototype dual-emission pattern (ingress + UI tag layer) — CON-3421.

2) Canary visibility in Console UI
- Current problem: rollout status shows % but no recent error trend; PMs keep asking for "errors in last 30m".
- Proposal: small panel under rollout detail: sparkline for 30m error-rate, mean latency, and fallback-rate. Minimal: 3 small tiles, then expand.
- UI constraints: Samira notes width budget in panel; will use compact-sparkline component (reuse from infra repo).
- Dev tasks: frontend (Samira) add panel, backend (Ethan) expose a short-timeseries endpoint (30m, 1m granularity). PR: GH/412 is the backend stub.

3) Quick rollout policy tweak (on whiteboard)
- Canary -> if fallback-rate > 3% for 5m, auto-pause and notify on #console-rollouts with runbook link.
- Keep manual override for SRE/Oncall.
- Action: Priya to update rollout engine spec and create CON-3499 for implementation and runbook link.

4) Instrumentation detail: sampling vs full traces
- Trace budget is tight. Suggest: sample 5% of low-error traffic, 100% of requests that trigger fallback or model mismatch. Add a 'trace_policy' tag on request context.
- Action: implement sample toggles in runtime router; TJ to coordinate with serving-runtime. Ticket: CON-3507 (placeholder).

5) UX / small bugs noted
- Bug: rollout modal loses scroll position when toggling variants. Repro: create canary, open variants list -> toggle -> modal jumps. Samira will investigate CSS/DOM re-render cause.
- UX ask: Add inline tooltip for "fallback" explaining what it means for PG teams (copy provided by PM). Lena to get copy.

6) Metrics + dashboards
- Priya: build lightweight dashboard for PM + SEs that surfaces the 3 metrics above and a token-cost delta estimate for canaries (approx tokens/sec * price).
- Need: cost formula (ask finance) — Samira to ping finance thread and link in dashboard ticket.

7) Action items recap (quick)
- TJ: prototype dual-emission pattern for enriched tags; draft infra PR. (owner: TJ; due: 2026-04-28)
- Ethan: complete backend timeseries endpoint (GH/412), wire to UI panel. (owner: Ethan; due: 2026-04-26)
- Samira: implement compact sparks and fix modal scroll bug; coordinate copy for tooltip. (owner: Samira; due: 2026-04-24)
- Priya: update rollout engine spec, add auto-pause rule, draft runbook. (owner: Priya; due: 2026-04-25)
- Lena: collect PM copy and confirm dashboard cost formula with finance; create dashboard ticket. (owner: Lena; due: 2026-04-23)

8) Blockers / risks
- Infra tagging: if we add tags at frontend only, some internal routing code won't see them for routing-level metrics -> risk of double-counting. Need alignment.
- Metrics cost: high-cardinality tags increase metrics cost; must keep tag set minimal. Agreed tags for now: route, model_variant, customer_tier, outcome (ok|fallback|error).

9) Next steps / follow-up cadence
- Quick sync Thurs 10am to confirm baseline metrics availability and mockups.
- Convert action items to tickets after lunch and assign.

NOTES TO SELF (Lena):
- remember to attach the mockup screenshot to CON-3499 and link the runbook.
- follow up with Omar about long-term plan for prefix caching visibility (he said early May).

Rough scribbles end. This is intentionally terse — will clean and split into tickets.
